generationPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production pixel-art VFX sprite sheet for a game.
Primary request: Yuji Itadori Black Flash spark, effect only, no character or fist. A violent, angular burst of black lightning with vivid crimson-red edges and a tiny pale pink impact point. Keep the black interiors substantial and red outer edges readable on a dark game UI.
Layout: square 1024x1024 transparent PNG, precisely 4 columns by 4 rows of equal 256x256 cells. Exactly sixteen animation frames, in reading order left to right then top to bottom. Each cell has its spark centered at exactly the same relative coordinate (128,128) with generous clear padding; all pixels must stay inside the central 208x208 area of each cell. NO gridlines, borders, labels, numbers or text.
Animation: one coherent 16-frame impact spark animation. Frames 1-3 small crackling red-black seed, 4-6 rapid explosive expansion into crooked branching lightning, 7-9 maximal asymmetric radial electric impact with sharp black cores and vivid red stepped rims, 10-13 branches break into small angular sparks, 14-16 recede into a small crackling seed that loops naturally back to frame 1. Keep the origin fixed, vary lightning silhouettes from frame to frame, do not translate or rotate one static drawing.
Style: authentic low-resolution pixel art, chunky square pixel clusters on a strict pixel grid, as if each cell was drawn at 64x64 and nearest-neighbor enlarged four times. Flat limited palette black/near-black, dark burgundy, saturated crimson red, hot red, a few pale pink highlights. Jagged bolt shapes, no smooth curves, no blur, no soft glow, no gradients, no antialiasing, no white backdrop, no checkerboard backdrop.
Background: genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside the spark. Effect only.
